test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the statements about Bihu festivals in Assam and choose the correct option:

1.) Goru Bihu of Kati Bihu involves sky lamps to attract pests.

2.) Uruka before Magh Bihu features bonfires and feasting.

3.) Manuh Bihu includes gifting Gamucha and traditional dishes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 2 and 3 are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement 1:** Goru Bihu of Kati Bihu involves sky lamps to attract pests.

 This statement is **incorrect**. Goru Bihu is part of Rongali Bihu and involves the ceremonial washing and worship of cattle, not the use of sky lamps. Sky lamps (locally called "Akash Banti") are part of Kati Bihu, but they are lit to guide spirits and not to attract pests.
 
• **Statement 2:** Uruka before Magh Bihu features bonfires and feasting.

 This statement is **correct**. Uruka is the evening before Magh Bihu when families and communities come together for feasting, and bonfires are an integral part of this celebration.
